_fixture: Sources-family fixtures (sources/add, sources/resolve, sources/format, sources/queue). Invented prototype data for Document 14 / 16 states. No link was resolved, no extractor ran, no byte was downloaded and no service was contacted: every identity, candidate, duration, bitrate, byte count, error, clock time and status below exists only to draw the states. Track and artist names are fictional. Adapter statuses are planning positions (Document 16 §2, §10), not test results — no adapter is verified working.

retention: Artwork: the source's thumbnail is kept as the source allows; a procedural placeholder is used otherwise. Spotify artwork is not copied.
Title and artist come from the file's own evidence. Spotify catalog fields are kept as a restricted reference and never sent to ParDay.
Processing history is saved with the file: source codec, output codec, re-encoding yes/no, extractor version.
